senses.gloss: Daiyāṃpāti, ‘descendant of Dayāṃpāta,’ is the name of a teacher of the east, who was instructed by śāṇḍilyāyana, according to the Śatapatha brāhmaṇa (ix. 5, 1, 14), in the lore of the construction of the fire-altar. The same patronymic is given, in the form of Dayyāṃpāti, to plakṣa, the contemporary of Atyaṃhas in the taittirīya brāhmaṇa (iii. 10, 9, 3-5).
